resume.summary: AI infrastructure engineer building reliable, efficient model-serving systems from prototype through production. Experienced in inference optimization, distributed platforms, and practical evaluation, with a focus on making machine learning services observable and easy for product teams to operate.

projects.name: Inference Bench
bullet_points: Built a configurable harness to compare throughput, tail latency, and memory use across inference backends, with realistic request shapes and repeatable traffic patterns under load.
Added repeatable workload fixtures and reports that make performance changes easy to review before deployment and help teams compare results across different hardware configurations.
Documented setup, interpretation, and trade-offs so engineers can reproduce benchmarks on a single GPU or a shared cluster and select a suitable backend for each workload in production.

projects.name: Signal Canvas
bullet_points: Created a dashboard linking request traces, queue depth, GPU utilization, and error rates for deployed models, making it easier to trace slow responses to resource constraints during incidents.
Implemented alert examples and a lightweight replay tool to help teams investigate latency regressions, reproduce failed requests, and compare behavior across releases and production environments.
Published a sample deployment with synthetic traffic and practical runbooks for local exploration, onboarding, and common troubleshooting exercises across serving environments with teammates.
Designed a shared inference platform for language and embedding models, giving product teams a consistent API, deployment templates, and a safer path from prototype to production.
Introduced dynamic batching and autoscaling based on queue pressure, reducing median serving cost by 31% across representative workloads while maintaining latency targets for customers.
Established latency budgets, tracing, and release checks that cut high-severity serving incidents by 40% over twelve months and made investigations faster for on-call engineers across teams.
Developed containerized services and deployment tooling for internal data products, improving release consistency across four engineering teams and simplifying operational handoffs for each release.
Built a load-testing pipeline and capacity reports that revealed bottlenecks before launches, reduced manual performance checks, and gave teams a shared baseline for planning and scaling.
Partnered with data scientists to package prediction models as monitored services, with documented ownership, deployment procedures, and tested rollback paths for each release in production.

extracurriculars.description: Maintain an open-source model evaluation toolkit and mentor engineers through a local machine learning reading group, organizing practical sessions on serving and reliability for practitioners.
